_why_this_file_is_hand_written: The drafting call reads context_set['llm_analysis'] for the JD breakdown. Running the real analyze pass just to produce it would add two paid calls (extraction + synthesis) to a probe whose whole point is to measure ONE call. These values are a faithful hand-read of jd.txt in the shape analyzer.analyze emits, frozen so the probe is comparable run-to-run. If jd.txt changes, re-read this by hand or the probe silently scores against a stale breakdown.
